accessibility.name: Accessibility
accessibility.purpose: Ensure every artifact preserves access through semantics, keyboard, focus, touch, contrast, reduced motion, language, localization, recovery, and fallback behavior.

roles.use: Every interactive control has visible or programmatic accessible name.
Native or ARIA role matches behavior.
Expanded, selected, busy, disabled, invalid, current announced correctly.
Visible focus, order, trap, restore, skip route.
Mobile and tablet controls meet target size.
Text, controls, status, charts, maps remain readable.
Errors explain cause, next step, support path, and escalation.

productExamples.example: Code inputs group labels, paste behavior, error announcement, resend timer, and fallback.
Permission denied state provides fallback station list and route action alternatives.
Every chart has title, description, text summary, legend, and keyboard-reachable data.
Permission matrix supports keyboard navigation, dependency warnings, and audit copy.

componentDependencies: Station Detail and Route Guidance pattern
agentInstructions: Start with native semantics before ARIA.
Define keyboard behavior and focus restoration for every interactive artifact.
Charts and maps require non-visual alternatives.
rejectIf: Accessibility appears only as a final checklist.
Keyboard path is missing or trapped.
Chart/map has no text or list alternative.
Error lacks recovery, support, or escalation path.
